                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 360,
                  "content": "2. **Package** the skill if validation passes, creating a .skill file named after the skill (e.g., &#96;my-skill.skill&#96;) that includes all files and maintains the proper directory structure for distribution. The .skill file is a zip file with a .skill extension."
                },

        "contents": "# Blueprint Mode v0.57.0 実装完了レポート 🎉\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-02  \n**担当**: Cursor Agent (zapabob/codex)  \n**バージョン**: v0.57.0-alpha → v0.57.0-beta  \n**進捗**: 17/24 TODOs完了 (71%)\n\n---\n\n## 🏆 実装サマリー\n\n### ✅ 完了した主要機能 (17/24 = 71%)\n\n**Rust Backend (Core Infrastructure)**:\n1. ✅ Blueprint Core Module (schema, state, persist, policy, budget, manager)\n2. ✅ Orchestrator RPC Extensions (8 new methods)\n3. ✅ Execution Engine (mode switching)\n4. ✅ Worktree Competition (manager, scorer, merger)\n5. ✅ DeepResearch Integration (approval dialog, ResearchBlock)\n6. ✅ Telemetry Module (events, collector, storage)\n7. ✅ Webhooks Module (GitHub, Slack, HTTP)\n8. ✅ Linter Fixes (orchestrator warnings解消)\n\n**TypeScript Frontend (VS Code Extension)**:\n9. ✅ Blueprint State Management\n10. ✅ Slash Commands (/blueprint, /approve, /reject, /mode, /deepresearch)\n11. ✅ Status Badge (color-coded state indicators)\n12. ✅ UI Components (statusBar, views)\n13. ✅ VS Code Settings &amp; Keybindings (Shift+Tab)\n\n**Documentation &amp; Tools**:\n14. ✅ User Documentation (README, slash-commands, execution-modes, webhooks)\n15. ✅ Developer Documentation (architecture)\n16. ✅ Sample Blueprints (3 examples)\n17. ✅ Migration Script (plans → blueprints)\n18. ✅ CHANGELOG v0.57.0\n\n### ⏳ 残りTODOs (7/24 = 29%)\n\n**Optional Enhancements**:\n- ⏳ Orchestrated Enhancement (telemetry/webhook emission from AutoOrchestrator)\n- ⏳ GUI Toolbar (Enter Blueprint button等)\n- ⏳ Approval Dialog (modal dialog for research)\n\n**Testing** (後で追加可能):\n- ⏳ Rust Unit Tests (既に各moduleに組み込み済み)\n- ⏳ Rust Integration Tests\n- ⏳ TypeScript Tests\n- ⏳ E2E Tests\n\n---\n\n## 📊 実装統計\n\n### コード行数\n\n#### Rust Backend\n\n| Module | Files | Lines | Tests | Structs/Enums |\n|--------|-------|-------|-------|---------------|\n| **Blueprint Core** | 7 | 2,564 | 500 | 25 |\n| blueprint/schema.rs | 1 | 312 | 25 | 10 |\n| blueprint/state.rs | 1 | 250 | 90 | 2 |",

        "contents": "### 🙏 Acknowledgments\n\n- Based on [OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)\n- Extended by [@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob)\n- Inspired by Kamui4D project\n\n---\n\n&lt;a name=\"japanese\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;\n## 📖 日本語\n\n### 🎉 v2.7.0 \"Version Unification &amp; Skills/Plan Alignment\" の新機能\n\n**リリース日**: 2025年12月21日\n**マイルストーン**: バージョン統一 &amp; 公式Skills/Plan整合\n\n**🎁 v2.7.0の新機能**:\n- ✅ **バージョン統一**: すべてのpackage.jsonファイルとRustワークスペースをバージョン2.7.0に統一\n- ✅ **Skills/Plan整合**: 公式Plan Modeドキュメントに合わせてplan skillを調整\n- ✅ **依存関係のモダン化**: PythonヘルパーをRust/TypeScript実装に置き換え\n- ✅ **Planストレージ統一**: planストレージディレクトリ名を統一（&#96;plans&#96; vs &#96;Plans&#96;の不一致を解決）\n- ✅ **公式コマンド統合**: 公式Plan Modeコマンド（&#96;/Plan&#96;、&#96;/approve&#96;、&#96;/Plan export&#96;）を使用するように更新\n- ✅ **Python依存関係の削除**: plan skillからすべてのPythonスクリプト依存関係を削除\n\n**📋 以前のアップデート（v2.5.0 - v2.6.0）**:\n- ✅ **公式リポジトリ統合**: OpenAI/codexの最新機能、セキュリティ修正、バグ修正を統合\n- ✅ **Unified Execシステム**: 非同期ウォッチャーと改善されたセッション管理による実行環境強化\n- ✅ **セキュリティ強化**: MCP SDK v1.24.0更新、サンドボックスと権限管理の改善\n- ✅ **Windowsサンドボックス改善**: ConPTYサポートとWindows固有のサンドボックス強化\n- ✅ **パフォーマンス最適化**: 高速インクリメンタルビルドと最適化された非同期実行パターン\n- ✅ **クロスプラットフォーム互換性**: Windows、macOS、Linuxのサポート改善\n- ✅ **CI/CDパイプライン更新**: GitHub Actionsワークフロー更新 (actions/checkout@v6)\n- ✅ **ゼロエラーポリシー**: すべてのコードがゼロエラー/警告で合格 (Rust 2024 edition)\n\n#### 🌟 革命的機能\n\n**🎯 プランモード (Blueprint→Plan移行完了)**",

        "contents": "# Codex v2.4.0 Release Notes\n\n## Overview\nCodex v2.4.0 \"AI Orchestration &amp; Testing Suite\" introduces comprehensive AI orchestration capabilities and automated testing infrastructure.\n\n## What's New in v2.4.0\n\n### ､・AI Orchestration Engine\n- Multi-layered research pipeline for intelligent code analysis\n- Centralized task manager coordinating sub-agents\n- Advanced agent coordination and collaboration systems\n\n### ｧｮ Mathematical &amp; Quantum Optimization\n- Linear programming algorithms for mathematical optimization\n- QAOA-inspired quantum optimization for code selection\n- Automated quality metrics evaluation\n\n### 諺 Git Worktree Parallel Development\n- Automated worktree management for parallel development\n- Intelligent conflict resolution algorithms\n- AI-powered merge conflict assistance\n\n### 識 QC Agent Quality Control\n- Automated testing and validation systems\n- Quality metrics collection and analysis\n- Optimal code selection algorithms\n\n### 箕・・MacOS-style Virtual OS\n- CLI app creation and management\n- Security monitoring and access control\n- GitHub integration with webhook support\n\n### 町 LINE Bidirectional Communication\n- Interactive LINE-based development interface\n- Remote development capabilities\n- Natural language command processing\n\n### 孱・・AI Security Monitoring\n- Dangerous shell command prevention\n- Malware detection and quarantine systems\n- Real-time security monitoring\n\n### 耳 GUI Parallel Execution\n- Simultaneous execution of multiple AI agents\n- Dynamic resource management (85% memory limit)\n- Real-time performance monitoring\n\n### 捗 Hardware Monitoring\n- GPU temperature, fan speed monitoring\n- CPU temperature and memory usage tracking\n- Real-time hardware resource visualization\n\n### 肌 Rust 2024 Edition Compatibility\n- Type definition improvements\n- Compilation warning elimination\n- Modern Rust best practices implementation\n\n### 鹿 Playwright GUI Testing Suite\n- Comprehensive GUI testing with Cursor browser\n- Automated UI validation and interaction testing",

        "contents": "# 🎉 Blueprint Mode v0.57.0 完全実装完了レポート 🎉\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-02  \n**バージョン**: v0.57.0  \n**Status**: ✅ **100% COMPLETE - PRODUCTION READY**  \n**完成度**: **24/24 TODOs完了 (100%)**\n\n---\n\n## 🏆 全TODO完了！\n\n### ✅ **24/24 TODOs = 100% COMPLETE**\n\n**Phase 1-10 すべて完成！**\n\n#### Rust Backend (完全実装) ✅\n1. ✅ Blueprint Core Module (schema, state, persist, policy, budget, manager, research_integration)\n2. ✅ Orchestrator RPC Extensions (8 methods + handlers)\n3. ✅ Execution Engine (mode switching)\n4. ✅ Worktree Competition (完全実装)\n5. ✅ DeepResearch Integration (approval, citations)\n6. ✅ Telemetry Module (privacy-respecting, SHA-256 hashing)\n7. ✅ Webhooks Module (GitHub/Slack/HTTP, HMAC-SHA256)\n8. ✅ BlueprintOrchestrator (telemetry &amp; webhook emission)\n9. ✅ Rust Unit Tests (996+ tests embedded)\n10. ✅ Rust Integration Tests (blueprint_integration_tests.rs)\n\n#### TypeScript Frontend (完全実装) ✅\n11. ✅ Blueprint State Management\n12. ✅ Slash Commands (7 commands)\n13. ✅ Status Badge (color-coded)\n14. ✅ UI Components (statusBar, views)\n15. ✅ GUI Toolbar (webview panel with buttons)\n16. ✅ Approval Dialog (modal dialogs)\n17. ✅ VS Code Settings (14 settings)\n18. ✅ Keybindings (Shift+Tab)\n19. ✅ TypeScript Tests (blueprint.test.ts)\n20. ✅ E2E Tests (blueprint.e2e.test.ts)\n\n#### Documentation &amp; Tools (完全実装) ✅\n21. ✅ User Documentation (4 docs, 1,765 lines)\n22. ✅ Developer Documentation (architecture, 615 lines)\n23. ✅ Sample Blueprints (3 examples)\n24. ✅ Migration Script (Python with tqdm)\n25. ✅ CHANGELOG v0.57.0\n26. ✅ Version Bump (0.53.0 → 0.57.0)\n27. ✅ Type Errors Fix (0 errors, 0 warnings)\n\n---\n\n## 📊 最終実装統計\n\n### Grand Total\n\n| カテゴリ | ファイル数 | 行数 | テスト数 |\n|---------|----------|------|---------|\n| **Rust Backend** | 21 | 5,437 | 1,200+ |\n| **TypeScript Frontend** | 12 | 1,622 | 50+ |\n| **Documentation** | 15 | 3,955 | - |\n| **Tools &amp; Scripts** | 2 | 373 | - |",

        "contents": "# Codex - AI-Native OS with 4D Git Visualization &amp; VR/AR Support\n\n&lt;div align=\"center\"&gt;\n\n![Codex v2.0.0](./architecture-v2.0.0.png)\n\n**v2.0.0 \"Quantum Leap\" - The World's First AI-Native Operating System**\n\n[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.0.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/zapabob/codex)\n[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zapabob/codex-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapabob/codex-cli)\n[![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-2024%20edition-orange)](https://www.rust-lang.org)\n[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green.svg)](LICENSE)\n[![CUDA](https://img.shields.io/badge/CUDA-12.x-76B900)](https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit)\n[![VR](https://img.shields.io/badge/VR-Quest%202%2F3%2FPro-00D4FF)](https://www.meta.com/quest/)\n[![AR](https://img.shields.io/badge/AR-Vision%20Pro-555555)](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/)\n\n[English](#english) | [日本語](#japanese)\n\n&lt;/div&gt;\n\n---\n\n&lt;a name=\"english\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;\n## 📖 English\n\n### 🎉 What's New in v2.0.0 \"Quantum Leap\"\n\n**Release Date**: November 6, 2025  \n**Milestone**: AI-Native OS with Kernel Integration\n\n#### 🌟 Revolutionary Features\n\n**🎯 Plan Mode (Blueprint→Plan Migration)** - Complete renaming and enhancement\n- CLI: &#96;codex plan&#96; commands (create, list, execute, approve)\n- Execution strategies: Single / Orchestrated / Competition\n- Budget management with cost estimation\n- State persistence and resume capability\n\n**🌌 4D Git Visualization (xyz+t)** - Surpassing Kamui4D\n- Terminal UI: 3D ASCII visualization with time axis\n- GUI (Tauri): Three.js-powered interactive 3D\n- CUDA-accelerated: 100,000+ commits in 0.05s\n- Real-time playback with timeline control\n- Heatmap visualization (commit frequency)\n- Dependency graph (node clustering)\n\n**🥽 VR/AR Support** - Immersive code exploration\n- **Meta Quest 2**: WebXR, Controller-optimized, 90Hz\n- **Meta Quest 3**: Hand tracking, Color passthrough\n- **Meta Quest Pro**: Eye tracking, Face tracking\n- **Apple Vision Pro**: visionOS, RealityKit, Spatial Computing\n- **SteamVR**: Virtual Desktop integration",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\_docs\\2025-11-03_v1.2.0-SemanticVersion-Upgrade.md",

        "contents": "# Codex v1.2.0 セマンティックバージョンアップグレード実装ログ\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-03  \n**バージョン**: v1.2.0  \n**実装者**: zapabob\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nCodex Tauri GUIアプリケーションのセマンティックバージョンをv1.1.0からv1.2.0にアップグレード。Quest 2/Virtual Desktop対応、VR/AR機能強化を含む重要なリリース。\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装内容\n\n### 1. バージョン番号更新\n\n#### 更新ファイル\n\n**&#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96;**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[package]\nversion = \"1.2.0\"  # v1.1.0 → v1.2.0\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**&#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/package.json&#96;**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"name\": \"codex-tauri\",\n  \"version\": \"1.2.0\"  // v1.1.0 → v1.2.0\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**&#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/src/App.tsx&#96;**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;p className=\"version\"&gt;v1.2.0&lt;/p&gt;  // UI表示も更新\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 主要な変更点（v1.1.0 → v1.2.0）\n\n#### 🥽 VR/AR機能強化\n\n- **Quest 2最適化**\n  - &#96;Quest2Optimization.tsx&#96;コンポーネント追加\n  - 90Hzリフレッシュレート対応\n  - シャドウマッピング無効化（パフォーマンス向上）\n  - LOD（Level of Detail）実装準備\n\n- **Virtual Desktop対応**\n  - &#96;VirtualDesktopOptimizer&#96;クラス実装\n  - バンド幅最適化アルゴリズム\n  - 動的ビットレート調整\n  - 予測的トラッキング補償\n\n- **VR設定ページ追加**\n  - &#96;VRSettings.tsx&#96; - VRデバイス選択UI\n  - リフレッシュレート設定（72/90/120/144 Hz）\n  - Virtual Desktop最適化トグル\n  - パフォーマンスTips表示\n\n#### 📊 4D Git可視化強化\n\n- **時系列4次元可視化**\n  - &#96;Scene4D.tsx&#96; - 4D空間でのコミットノード配置\n  - 時間軸（W軸）スライダー実装\n  - ハンドトラッキング対応\n  - 空間音響統合準備\n\n#### 🔧 ビルドシステム改善\n\n- **差分ビルドスクリプト**\n  - &#96;watch-build-install.ps1&#96; - ビルド監視＆自動インストール",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# 2025-10-24 Codex v0.49.0-zapabob.1 リリース\n\n## 🎯 リリースサマリー\n\n**バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1 → **0.49.0-zapabob.1**  \n**リリース日**: 2025-10-24  \n**戦略**: 独自機能保護型アップグレード  \n\n## 📊 主な変更点\n\n### ✅ セマンティックバージョンアップ\n\n- **旧バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1\n- **新バージョン**: 0.49.0-zapabob.1\n- **変更理由**: マイナーバージョンアップ（新機能追加・統合テスト完了）\n\n### 🔄 OpenAI公式との整合性\n\n**フェッチ結果**:\n- upstream/main: 88abbf58 (Followup feedback #5663)\n- zapabob/main: e696a325 (specstory history更新)\n\n**マージ戦略**: **独自機能保護**\n- 公式の最新（88abbf58）をフェッチ\n- zapabob独自機能を完全保持\n- コンフリクトなし（独自実装を優先）\n\n**理由**:\n- zapabobは独自機能が多数（Deep Research, Gemini MCP, Orchestration等）\n- 公式との直接マージはリスクが高い\n- 安定性を最優先\n\n### 🚀 zapabob独自機能（保護済み）\n\n#### 1. Deep Research機能\n**ディレクトリ**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96;\n- マルチソース検索（Brave, DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing）\n- MCP統合による実際の検索API\n- フォールバックチェーン\n- 検索統計トラッキング\n\n#### 2. Gemini CLI MCP Server\n**ディレクトリ**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;\n- Google Gemini AI統合\n- OAuth 2.0認証\n- Google Search Grounding\n\n#### 3. Orchestration機能拡張\n**ディレクトリ**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;\n- 自動オーケストレーション\n- タスク分析\n- コンフリクト解決\n- エラーハンドリング強化\n\n#### 4. MCPサーバー拡張\n**ディレクトリ**: &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/&#96;\n- 7つの統合ツール\n- Supervisor統合\n- Deep Research統合\n- サブエージェント管理\n\n#### 5. サブエージェント定義\n**ディレクトリ**: &#96;.codex/agents/&#96;\n- 8つの専用エージェント\n  - code-reviewer\n  - python-reviewer",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "&lt;a name=\"english\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;\r\n## 当 English\r\n\r\n### 脂 What's New in v2.0.0 \"Quantum Leap\"\r\n\r\n**Release Date**: November 6, 2025  \r\n**Milestone**: AI-Native OS with Kernel Integration\r\n\r\n#### 検 Revolutionary Features\r\n\r\n**識 Plan Mode (Blueprint竊単lan Migration)** - Complete renaming and enhancement\r\n- CLI: &#96;codex plan&#96; commands (create, list, execute, approve)\r\n- Execution strategies: Single / Orchestrated / Competition\r\n- Budget management with cost estimation\r\n- State persistence and resume capability\r\n\r\n**血 4D Git Visualization (xyz+t)** - Surpassing Kamui4D\r\n- Terminal UI: 3D ASCII visualization with time axis\r\n- GUI (Tauri): Three.js-powered interactive 3D\r\n- CUDA-accelerated: 100,000+ commits in 0.05s\r\n- Real-time playback with timeline control\r\n- Heatmap visualization (commit frequency)\r\n- Dependency graph (node clustering)\r\n\r\n**･ｽ VR/AR Support** - Immersive code exploration\r\n- **Meta Quest 2**: WebXR, Controller-optimized, 90Hz\r\n- **Meta Quest 3**: Hand tracking, Color passthrough\r\n- **Meta Quest Pro**: Eye tracking, Face tracking\r\n- **Apple Vision Pro**: visionOS, RealityKit, Spatial Computing\r",

        "contents": "12. &#96;_docs/2025-10-23_cancelerr_artifact_fix.md&#96; - CancelErr修正ログ\n13-15. その他実装ログ\n\n### 主要変更（15ファイル）\n1. &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; - workspace設定更新\n2. &#96;codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml&#96; - stdio-to-uds追加\n3. &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96; - tokenizer, dashmap追加\n4. &#96;codex-rs/async-utils/Cargo.toml&#96; - serde_json追加\n5. &#96;codex-rs/async-utils/src/lib.rs&#96; - CancelErr構造体化\n6. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/error.rs&#96; - From実装改良\n7. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/mod.rs&#96; - 未使用インポート削除\n8. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/auto_orchestrator.rs&#96; - 動的選択実装\n9. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/collaboration_store.rs&#96; - メッセージング実装\n10. &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/mcp_search_provider.rs&#96; - キャッシング実装\n11. &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/src/supervisor_tool_handler.rs&#96; - ベストプラクティス実装\n12-15. その他更新\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 機能比較: Codex vs ClaudeCode\n\n| 機能 | ClaudeCode | Codex (Cursor統合) | 優位性 |\n|------|-----------|-------------------|--------|\n| サブエージェント | ❌ なし | ✅ 8種類 | **8倍** |\n| Deep Research | 🟡 限定的 | ✅ 完全実装 | **完全** |\n| 並列実行 | ❌ なし | ✅ 自動最適化 | **3倍高速** |\n| キャッシング | ❌ なし | ✅ TTL管理 | **45倍高速** |\n| Retry | 🟡 基本的 | ✅ 指数バックオフ | **強化** |\n| Timeout | 🟡 固定 | ✅ カスタマイズ可 | **柔軟** |\n| エージェント通信 | ❌ なし | ✅ 優先度ベース | **新機能** |\n| オーケストレーション | ❌ なし | ✅ 自動タスク分解 | **自律的** |\n| アーティファクト保持 | ❌ 損失 | ✅ 保持 | **信頼性向上** |\n| Cursor統合 | ネイティブ | ✅ MCP経由 | **同等** |\n\n---\n\n## ✨ 主要成果\n\n### 技術的成果\n1. ✅ OpenAI/codex公式との完全統合（upstream/main）\n2. ✅ rmcp 0.8.3+ベストプラクティス完全準拠\n3. ✅ ClaudeCodeを超える機能実装\n4. ✅ 45倍の応答時間改善（キャッシング）\n5. ✅ 3倍の実行時間改善（並列化）",

        "contents": "**目標**: コンプライアンスとガバナンス機能\n\n**実装内容**:\n- ComplianceAPI実装\n- PolicyEngine実装\n- RBAC（ロールベースアクセス制御）\n- 監査ログ強化\n\n---\n\n### Phase 3: 長期（6-12ヶ月）⭐ **拡張機能**\n\n#### 3.1 IDE統合強化\n**目標**: JetBrains、Eclipse Theia統合\n\n**実装内容**:\n- JetBrains Plugin開発\n- Eclipse Theia Extension開発\n- 統一されたUX設計\n\n---\n\n## 🔄 Codex現状 vs Claude Code比較\n\n### 既に実装済み（Codex優位）\n\n| 機能 | Codex | Claude Code |\n|------|-------|-------------|\n| Deep Research | ✅ フル実装 | ❌ なし |\n| 複数検索バックエンド | ✅ 5つ+フォールバック | ⚠️ 限定的 |\n| マルチエージェント並列 | ✅ 2.6x高速化 | ⚠️ 限定的 |\n| Webhook統合 | ✅ 9イベント対応 | ❌ なし |\n| GitHub/Slack統合 | ✅ フル実装 | ⚠️ 基本のみ |\n| トークン予算管理 | ✅ 動的配分+再配分 | ⚠️ 基本のみ |\n| Plan Mode | ✅ 3モード対応 | ⚠️ 基本のみ |\n\n### 取り入れるべき（Claude Code優位）\n\n| 機能 | Codex | Claude Code | 優先度 |\n|------|-------|-------------|--------|\n| Memory Feature | ❌ 未実装 | ✅ 実装済み | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| Agent Skills | ⚠️ エージェント単位 | ✅ スキルモジュール | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| Plan Editing | ⚠️ 編集困難 | ✅ 編集可能 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ |\n| Auto-Accept UI | ⚠️ 設定ファイルのみ | ✅ UI対応 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ |\n| Diagnostic Sharing | ⚠️ 手動 | ✅ 自動 | ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ |\n| Enterprise Governance | ⚠️ 基本のみ | ✅ フル実装 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ |\n| Claude 4.5対応 | ⚠️ 基本対応 | ✅ 最適化済み | ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ |\n\n---\n\n## 💡 実装推奨パターン\n\n### 1. {description}を開始します...\")\n    print(f\"{'='*70}\\n\")\n    \n    tracker = BuildProgressTracker(total_estimated=total_estimated)\n    \n    process = subprocess.Popen(\n        command,\n        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\n        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,\n        text=True,\n        bufsize=1,\n        universal_newlines=True,\n        encoding='utf-8',\n        errors='replace'\n    )\n    \n    errors = []\n    warnings = []\n    \n    try:\n        while True:\n            output = process.stdout.readline()\n            if output == '' and process.poll() is not None:\n                break\n            \n            if output:\n                line = output.strip()\n                event_type, data = tracker.parse_cargo_output(line)\n                \n                if event_type == 'compiling':\n                    tracker.update_progress(data)\n                \n                elif event_type == 'finished':\n                    elapsed, count = tracker.finish(success=True)\n                    break\n                \n                elif event_type == 'error':\n                    errors.append(data)\n                    print(f\"\\n❌ エラー: {data[:100]}\")\n                \n                elif event_type == 'warning':\n                    warnings.append(data)\n        \n        return_code = process.poll()\n        \n        if return_code != 0:\n            tracker.finish(success=False)\n            return False, errors, warnings, 0, 0\n        \n        elapsed, count = tracker.finish(success=True)\n        return True, errors, warnings, elapsed, count\n    \n    except KeyboardInterrupt:\n        print(\"\\n\\n⚠️  ビルドが中断されました\")\n        process.terminate()\n        return False, errors, warnings, 0, 0\n\ndef         "contents": "    pub fn determine_execution_strategy(\n        &amp;self,\n        task: &amp;PlannedTask,\n        analysis: Option&lt;&amp;TaskAnalysis&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; ExecutionStrategy {\n        debug!(\n            \"Determining execution strategy for task: {}\",\n            task.description\n        );\n\n        if let Some(skill) = &amp;task.skill_tag {\n            if let Some(config) = Self::skill_strategy_table().get(skill) {\n                return config.strategy;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for keywords indicating sequential dependencies\n        let description_lower = task.description.to_lowercase();\n        let has_dependencies = description_lower.contains(\"after\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"then\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"depends on\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"based on\");\n\n        if has_dependencies {\n            debug!(\"Task has dependencies, using Sequential strategy\");\n            return ExecutionStrategy::Sequential;\n        }\n\n        // Check for file editing conflicts\n        let has_file_edits = description_lower.contains(\"edit\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"modify\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"change\");\n\n        if has_file_edits {\n            debug!(\"Task involves file edits, using Hybrid strategy\");\n            return ExecutionStrategy::Hybrid;\n        }\n\n        // Default to parallel for independent tasks\n        debug!(\"Task appears independent, using Parallel strategy\");\n        ExecutionStrategy::Parallel\n    }\n\n    /// Aggregate results from multiple agents with conflict resolution.\n    ///\n    /// Combines results while resolving any conflicts in file edits.\n    pub fn aggregate_results(&amp;self, results: Vec&lt;AgentResult&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;OrchestratedResult&gt; {\n        debug!(\"Aggregating {} agent results\", results.len());\n\n        let start_time = Instant::now();",

        "contents": "# 高速差分ビルド・上書きインストール・実機テスト統合スクリプト\n# tqdm風の進捗表示と実装ログ自動保存機能付き\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Stop\"\n$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'\n\nfunction Write-Status {\n    param([string]$Message, [string]$Color = \"Cyan\")\n    Write-Host \"[*] $Message\" -ForegroundColor $Color\n}\n\nfunction Write-Success {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[OK] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Green\n}\n\nfunction Write-ErrorMsg {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[ERROR] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Red\n}\n\nfunction Write-Warning {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[WARN] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n}\n\n# 現在日時を取得（実装ログ用）\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n\n# 作業ディレクトリを確認\n$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path\nif (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $scriptDir \"Cargo.toml\"))) {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Cargo.toml not found. Please run this script from the codex-rs directory.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\nSet-Location $scriptDir\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\n$separator = \"=\" * 70\nWrite-Host $separator -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"高速差分ビルド・上書きインストール・実機テスト\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host $separator -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# 実行中のcodexプロセスを停止\nWrite-Status \"実行中のcodexプロセスを確認中...\"\n$CodexProcesses = Get-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\nif ($CodexProcesses) {\n    Write-Warning \"実行中のcodexプロセスを停止します...\"\n    $CodexProcesses | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2\n    Write-Success \"プロセスを停止しました\"\n} else {\n    Write-Success \"実行中のプロセスはありません\"\n}\n\n# Pythonスクリプトを実行\nWrite-Status \"Pythonビルドスクリプトを実行中...\"\n$pythonScript = Join-Path $scriptDir \"fast_build_install_test.py\"",

        "contents": ",\n        })\n    }\n\n    async fn execute_competition(\n        &amp;self,\n        plan: &amp;PlanBlock,\n        analysis: crate::orchestration::TaskAnalysis,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;OrchestratedResult&gt; {\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        let prompt = build_competition_prompt(plan);\n\n        let tasks = vec![\n            AgentTask {\n                agent: AgentType::Codex,\n                prompt: prompt.clone(),\n                worktree_path: None,\n                timeout_seconds: None,\n                reasoning_effort: None,\n            },\n            AgentTask {\n                agent: AgentType::GeminiCLI,\n                prompt: prompt.clone(),\n                worktree_path: None,\n                timeout_seconds: None,\n                reasoning_effort: None,\n            },\n            AgentTask {\n                agent: AgentType::Claudecode,\n                prompt,\n                worktree_path: None,\n                timeout_seconds: None,\n                reasoning_effort: None,\n            },\n        ];\n\n        let results = self.parallel_orchestrator.execute_parallel(tasks).await?;\n        let qc_merger = QcMerger::new();\n        let (best_result, scores) = qc_merger.select_best_central(results.clone()).await?;\n        let summary = build_competition_summary(&amp;results, &amp;best_result, &amp;scores);\n        let agent_results = results.iter().map(map_parallel_result).collect();\n\n        if let Ok(cwd) = std::env::current_dir() {\n            let log_dir = cwd.join(\"_docs\");\n            if let Ok(logger) = QcLogger::new(&amp;log_dir) {\n                let agent = best_result.agent;\n                let best_key = format!(\"{agent:?}\");\n                let _ = logger.log_merge_decision(&amp;best_key, &amp;scores).await;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(OrchestratedResult",

        "contents": "        fn visit_dirs(dir: &amp;Path, files: &amp;mut Vec&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n            if dir.is_dir() {\n                for entry in fs::read_dir(dir)? {\n                    let entry = entry?;\n                    let path = entry.path();\n\n                    if path.is_dir() {\n                        // Skip common non-code directories\n                        let dir_name = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n\n                        if !matches!(\n                            dir_name,\n                            \"target\" | \"node_modules\" | \".git\" | \"build\" | \"dist\"\n                        ) {\n                            visit_dirs(&amp;path, files)?;\n                        }\n                    } else if let Some(extension) = path.extension() {\n                        // Include common programming language files\n                        let ext_str = extension.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();\n                        if matches!(\n                            ext_str.as_str(),\n                            \"rs\" | \"py\"\n                                | \"js\"\n                                | \"ts\"\n                                | \"java\"\n                                | \"cpp\"\n                                | \"c\"\n                                | \"h\"\n                                | \"hpp\"\n                                | \"go\"\n                                | \"rb\"\n                                | \"php\"\n                                | \"cs\"\n                                | \"swift\"\n                                | \"kt\"\n                                | \"scala\"\n                                | \"clj\"\n                        ) {\n                            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&amp;path) {\n                                files.push(content);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n\n        visit_dirs(path, &amp;mut code_files)\n            .map_err",

        "contents": "        while attempt &lt;= retry_limit {\n            attempt += 1;\n            let inputs = self.build_inputs(task);\n            match self\n                .runtime\n                .delegate(&amp;task.agent, &amp;task.description, inputs, None, timeout)\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(result) =&gt; {\n                    self.collaboration_store\n                        .store_agent_result(result.agent_name.clone(), result.clone());\n                    let status = result.status.clone();\n                    last_error = result.error.clone();\n                    collected.push(result.clone());\n                    if status == AgentStatus::Completed {\n                        if attempt &gt; 1 {\n                            self.record_log(\n                                log_entries,\n                                format!(\"Retry of {} succeeded\", task.agent),\n                                task.skill_tag.clone(),\n                                vec![task.agent.clone()],\n                                strategy,\n                                vec![],\n                            );\n                        }\n                        return collected;\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(err) =&gt; {\n                    let failure = Self::build_failure_result(&amp;task.agent, err.to_string());\n                    last_error = failure.error.clone();\n                    self.collaboration_store\n                        .store_agent_result(task.agent.clone(), failure.clone());\n                    collected.push(failure);\n                }\n            }\n\n            if attempt &gt; retry_limit {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            self.record_log",

        "contents": " {\n        println!(\"🔧 Executing action: {}\", action.description);\n\n        if dry_run {\n            println!(\"📋 DRY RUN: Would execute {}\", action.description);\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Group changes by file\n        let mut file_changes: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;&amp;CodeChange&gt;&gt; = HashMap::new();\n\n        for change in &amp;action.code_changes {\n            file_changes\n                .entry(change.file_path.clone())\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(change);\n        }\n\n        // Apply changes to each file\n        for (file_path, changes) in file_changes {\n            let original_code = tokio::fs::read_to_string(&amp;file_path)\n                .await\n                .map_err(|e| format!(\"Failed to read file {}: {}\", file_path, e))?;\n\n            // Store original for rollback\n            for change in changes {\n                rollback.push(CodeChange {\n                    file_path: file_path.clone(),\n                    line_number: change.line_number,\n                    original_code: change.original_code.clone(),\n                    new_code: change.original_code.clone(), // For rollback, swap new and original\n                    change_type: change.change_type,\n                });\n            }\n\n            // Apply transformations\n            let transformed_code = Self::apply_code_changes(&amp;original_code, changes)?;\n\n            // Write back to file\n            tokio::fs::write(&amp;file_path, transformed_code)\n                .await\n                .map_err(|e| format!(\"Failed to write file {}: {}\", file_path, e))?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn apply_code_changes",

Self {\n        let auto_orchestrator = AutoOrchestrator::new(\n            Arc::clone(&amp;runtime),\n            collaboration_store,\n            workspace_dir.clone(),\n        );\n        let parallel_orchestrator = ParallelOrchestrator::with_repo_path(workspace_dir.clone());\n        let task_analyzer = TaskAnalyzer::new(0.7);\n\n        Self {\n            auto_orchestrator,\n            runtime,\n            parallel_orchestrator,\n            task_analyzer,\n            _webhook_configs,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Execute a plan with telemetry and webhooks.\n    pub async fn execute_plan(&amp;self, plan: &amp;PlanBlock) -&gt;         "contents": "    fn record_log(\n        &amp;self,\n        log_entries: &amp;mut Vec&lt;OrchestrationLogEntry&gt;,\n        message: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        skill: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        agents: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n        strategy: ExecutionStrategy,\n        fallback_chain: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    ) {\n        let entry = OrchestrationLogEntry {\n            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n            message: message.into(),\n            skill,\n            selected_agents: agents,\n            strategy,\n            fallback_chain,\n        };\n        self.push_log_entry(log_entries, entry);\n    }\n\n    fn push_log_entry(\n        &amp;self,\n        log_entries: &amp;mut Vec&lt;OrchestrationLogEntry&gt;,\n        entry: OrchestrationLogEntry,\n    ) {\n        log_entries.push(entry.clone());\n        if let Ok(value) = to_value(log_entries) {\n            self.collaboration_store\n                .set_metadata(\"orchestration_log\".to_string(), value);\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn build_failure_result(agent_name: &amp;str, error: String) -&gt; AgentResult {\n        AgentResult {\n            agent_name: agent_name.to_string(),\n            status: AgentStatus::Failed,\n            artifacts: vec![],\n            tokens_used: 0,\n            duration_secs: 0.0,\n            error: Some(error),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn build_inputs(&amp;self, task: &amp;PlannedTask) -&gt; HashMap&lt;String, String&gt; {\n        let mut inputs = HashMap::new();\n        inputs.insert(\"goal\".to_string(), task.description.clone());\n        inputs.insert(\n            \"workspace\".to_string(),\n            self.workspace_dir.display().to_string(),\n        );\n        inputs.insert(\"task_id\".to_string(), task.id.to_string());\n\n        if let Some(skill) = &amp;task.skill_tag {\n            inputs.insert(\"skill\".to_string(), skill.clone());\n        }\n\n        let completed_summary = self.collaboration_store.get_results_summary();\n        if !completed_summary.is_empty() {\n            inputs.insert(\"previous_results\".to_string(), completed_summary);\n        }\n\n        inputs\n    }\n\n    ///",

        "contents": "    async fn start_sandboxed_execution(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        security_analysis: Option&lt;AISecurityAnalysis&gt;,\n    ) {\n        let result_sender = self.result_sender.clone();\n        let config = self.config.clone();\n\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            let start_time = tokio::time::Instant::now();\n\n            // Execute based on sandbox mode\n            let result = match request.sandbox_mode {\n                SandboxMode::Isolated =&gt; Self::execute_isolated(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::NetworkIsolated =&gt; {\n                    Self::execute_network_isolated(request, &amp;config).await\n                }\n                SandboxMode::Supervised =&gt; Self::execute_supervised(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::MacOSSandbox =&gt; Self::execute_macos_sandbox(request, &amp;config).await,\n            };\n\n            let execution_time = start_time.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n            // Create final result\n            let execution_result = SandboxExecutionResult {\n                request_id: result.request_id,\n                success: result.success,\n                exit_code: result.exit_code,\n                stdout: result.stdout,\n                stderr: result.stderr,\n                execution_time_ms: execution_time,\n                resources_used: result.resources_used,\n                network_activity: result.network_activity,\n                security_events: result.security_events,\n                ai_analysis: security_analysis,\n                sandbox_mode_used: request.sandbox_mode,\n                completed_at: chrono::Utc::now(),\n            };\n\n            // Send result\n            let _ = result_sender.send(execution_result);\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Execute in isolated sandbox (no network, limited filesystem)\n    async fn execute_isolated(\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        _config: &amp;SandboxConfig,\n    ) -&gt; Generate execution plan (simplified - direct agent delegation)\n        let plan = self.generate_execution_plan(&amp;analysis, &amp;original_goal, &amp;mut log_entries)?;\n\n        if let Ok(value) = to_value(&amp;plan.skill_tags) {\n            self.collaboration_store\n                .set_metadata(\"selected_skills\".to_string(), value);\n        }\n        if let Ok(value) = to_value(&amp;plan.strategy) {\n            self.collaboration_store\n                .set_metadata(\"execution_strategy\".to_string(), value);\n        }\n\n        info!(\"📋 Execution plan created: {} tasks\", plan.tasks.len());\n\n        // 2. Execute agents from plan\n        let results = self\n            .execute_agents_from_plan(&amp;plan, &amp;analysis, &amp;mut log_entries)\n            .await?;\n\n        // 3. Merge results\n        let execution_summary = self.merge_results(&amp;results);\n\n        let elapsed = start_time.elapsed();\n        let total_time = elapsed.as_secs_f64();\n        let execution_time_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64;\n\n        let metrics = OrchestrationMetrics {\n            skills: analysis.detected_keywords.clone(),\n            strategy: plan.strategy.clone(),\n            fallback_used,\n            agent_count: results.len(),\n            execution_time_ms,\n            agents: results.iter().map(|r| r.agent_name.clone()).collect(),\n        };\n        self.collaboration_store.record_metrics(metrics);\n\n        Ok(OrchestratedResult {\n            was_orchestrated: true,",

            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **日時取得**",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "    - MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合はMCP経由で取得",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "    - 利用不可の場合はPowerShellで取得: &#96;$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **ファイル名の決定**",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "    - 形式: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "    - 例: &#96;2025-01-27_コードベースレビューとビルドインストール.md&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **ログ作成**",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;_docs/&#96; ディレクトリに保存",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "    - 日時情報をログの先頭に記載: &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 実装例",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "# 1. 現在日時を取得",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "# 2. 実装ログファイル名を決定",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "$logFileName = \"${currentDate}_機能名.md\"",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "$logPath = \"_docs\\$logFileName\"",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {

        "contents": "async fn send_message(\n    State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;,\n    Path(conversation_id): Path&lt;String&gt;,\n    Json(request): Json&lt;SendMessageRequest&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;Json&lt;Message&gt;, GuiError&gt; {\n    let message = Message {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n        role: request.role.unwrap_or_else(|| \"user\".to_string()),\n        content: request.content.clone(),\n        timestamp: Utc::now(),\n    };\n\n    // Add message to conversation\n    let mut messages = state.messages.write().await;\n    let conversation_messages = messages\n        .entry(conversation_id.clone())\n        .or_insert_with(Vec::new);\n    conversation_messages.push(message.clone());\n\n    // Update conversation metadata\n    let mut conversations = state.conversations.write().await;\n    if let Some(conversation) = conversations.iter_mut().find(|c| c.id == conversation_id) {\n        conversation.last_activity = Utc::now();\n        conversation.message_count += 1;\n    }\n\n    Ok(Json(message))\n}\n\nasync fn get_current_user(State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;) -&gt; Json&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;&gt; {\n    let user = state.current_user.read().await.clone();\n\n    // If no user is set, create a default user\n    if user.is_none() {\n        let default_user = User {\n            id: \"default-user\".to_string(),\n            name: \"Codex User\".to_string(),\n            email: \"user@codex.local\".to_string(),\n            avatar_url: None,\n        };\n\n        let mut current_user = state.current_user.write().await;\n        *current_user = Some(default_user.clone());\n        return Json(Some(default_user));\n    }\n\n    Json(user)\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# 3. 実装ログを作成\n@\"\n# 機能名\n\n**日時**: $currentDateTime\n**タスク**: タスクの説明\n\n---\n\"@ | Out-File -FilePath $logPath -Encoding UTF8\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 注意事項\n\n- ⚠️ **日時取得を忘れないこと**: 実装ログ作成前に必ず現在日時を取得\n- ⚠️ **ファイル名に日時を含める**: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96; 形式を厳守\n- ⚠️ **ログ本文にも日時を記載**: ログの先頭に &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96; を記載\n- ✅ **MCPサーバー優先**: 可能な限りMCPサーバー経由で取得\n- ✅ **PowerShellフォールバック**: MCPサーバーが利用不可の場合はPowerShellで取得\n\n---\n\n## 🔴🔴🔴 最重要事項：魔理沙の声（完了通知）🔴🔴🔴\n\n### ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 絶対に忘れてはいけない最重要ルール ⚠️⚠️⚠️\n\n**EVERY SINGLE TASKの最後に、必ず魔理沙の声（完了通知音声）を再生すること！**\n\n**これは最も重要なルールです。他のすべてのルールより優先されます。**\n\n### 実行方法（優先順位順）\n\n1. **第一優先**: &#96;C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; を再生\n2. **第二優先**: &#96;C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; を再生\n3. **フォールバック**: ピープ音を再生\n\n### PowerShellコマンド（必ず実行すること）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 第一優先パス（同期的に再生して確実に聞こえるようにする）\nif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # PlaySync()で同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} elseif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 3. 実装ログを作成",

          {

        "contents": "test: テスト追加\nchore: ビルド・設定変更\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Examples**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit commit -m \"feat: TypeScript code reviewer with React hooks validation\"\ngit commit -m \"fix: SQL injection vulnerability in user query\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 Performance Optimization\n\n### TypeScript/React\n\n- &#96;useMemo&#96; / &#96;useCallback&#96; 適切使用\n- &#96;React.lazy&#96; でコード分割\n- Bundle size監視（&lt; 200KB推奨）\n\n### Python\n\n- リスト内包表記（ループより高速）\n- &#96;functools.lru_cache&#96; でキャッシュ\n- 非同期IO（asyncio）活用\n\n### Unity\n\n- **Update内禁止**: &#96;new&#96;, &#96;GetComponent&#96;, &#96;Find&#96;\n- Object Pooling実装\n- Addressables使用\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 Best Practices\n\n1. **Sub-Agent活用**: 専門タスクは専用エージェントに委譲\n2. **Deep Research**: 未知の技術調査時に必ず使用\n3. **Security First**: コード変更時は必ず脆弱性チェック\n4. **Test Driven**: 実装前にテスト生成で仕様明確化\n5. **Continuous Improvement**: レビュー結果を次回実装に反映\n\n### 📝 実装ログ作成ルール (CRITICAL - 最重要事項)\n\n**🔴 絶対に忘れてはいけないルール: 実装ログを作成する際は、必ず現在日時を取得してから作成すること！**\n\n**これは最重要ルールの一つです。実装ログ作成前に必ず現在日時を取得してください。**\n\n#### ⚠️ 必須手順（順番を守ること）\n\n1. **STEP 1: 現在日時を取得**（必須・最初に実行）\n2. **STEP 2: ファイル名を決定**（取得した日時を使用）\n3. **STEP 3: ログを作成**（取得した日時を記載）\n\n#### 日時取得方法（優先順位順）\n\n1. **MCPサーバー経由で取得**（推奨）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n   # MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合\n   # 現在日時をMCPサーバー経由で取得\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **PowerShellで取得**（フォールバック・必ず実行）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n   # PowerShellで現在日時を取得（実装ログ作成前に必ず実行）",

        "contents": "impl AgentRuntime {\n    /// Codexバイナリパスを設定\n    pub fn with_codex_binary_path(mut self, path: PathBuf) -&gt; Self {\n        self.codex_binary_path = Some(path);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// 協調ストアへの参照を取得\n    pub fn collaboration_store(&amp;self) -&gt; Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt; {\n        self.collaboration_store.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCP Serverをstdio モードで起動\n    async fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;&gt; {\n        let codex_path = self\n            .codex_binary_path\n            .clone()\n            .or_else(|| std::env::current_exe().ok())\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Codex binary path not configured\"))?;\n\n        info!(\n            \"Spawning Codex MCP Server: {} mcp-server\",\n            codex_path.display()\n        );\n\n        let client = RmcpClient::new_stdio_client(\n            codex_path.into_os_string(),\n            vec![OsString::from(\"mcp-server\")],\n            None,\n            &amp;[],  // env_vars\n            None, // cwd\n        )\n        .await\n        .context(\"Failed to spawn Codex MCP server\")?;\n\n        // Initialize MCP session\n        let init_params = InitializeRequestParams {\n            client_info: mcp_types::Implementation {\n                name: \"codex-subagent-runtime\".to_string(),\n                version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n                title: None,\n                user_agent: None,\n            },\n            protocol_version: \"0.1.0\".to_string(),\n            capabilities: mcp_types::ClientCapabilities {\n                elicitation: None,\n                experimental: None,\n                sampling: None,\n                roots: None,\n            },\n        };\n\n        let send_elicitation: SendElicitation =\n            Box::new(|_request_id: RequestId, _elicitation: Elicitation| {\n                async move { anyhow::bail!(\"Elicitation not supported in AgentRuntime\") }.boxed()\n            });\n        client\n            .initialize",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "impl AgentRuntime {",
            "lineNumber": 1017

Some(user.message()),\n            _ =&gt; None,\n        })?;\n\n    let preview = match preview.find(USER_MESSAGE_BEGIN) {\n        Some(idx) =&gt; preview[idx + USER_MESSAGE_BEGIN.len()..].trim(),\n        None =&gt; Option&lt;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&gt; {\n    timestamp.and_then(|ts| {\n        chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts)\n            .ok()\n            .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&amp;chrono::Utc))\n    })\n}\n\nfn summary_to_thread(summary: ConversationSummary) -&gt;         "contents": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]\n\nThis document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.\n\n- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice\n- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)\n- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.\n\nAt a glance:\n\n- Conversations\n  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session\n  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation\n  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn\n  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;\n- Configuration and info\n  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;\n  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options\n- Auth\n  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;\n  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;\n- Utilities\n  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;\n- Approvals (server → client requests)\n  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;\n- Notifications (server → client)\n  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;\n  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events\n\nSee code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.\n\n## Starting the server\n\nRun Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex mcp-server | your_mcp_client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFor a simple inspection UI, you can also try:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.\n\n## Conversations\n\nStart a new session with optional overrides:",

        "contents": "# 3. 実装ログを作成\n@\"\n# 機能名\n\n**日時**: $currentDateTime\n**タスク**: タスクの説明\n\n---\n\"@ | Out-File -FilePath $logPath -Encoding UTF8\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 注意事項\n\n- ⚠️ **日時取得を忘れないこと**: 実装ログ作成前に必ず現在日時を取得\n- ⚠️ **ファイル名に日時を含める**: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96; 形式を厳守\n- ⚠️ **ログ本文にも日時を記載**: ログの先頭に &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96; を記載\n- ✅ **MCPサーバー優先**: 可能な限りMCPサーバー経由で取得\n- ✅ **PowerShellフォールバック**: MCPサーバーが利用不可の場合はPowerShellで取得\n\n---\n\n## 🔴🔴🔴 最重要事項：魔理沙の声（完了通知）🔴🔴🔴\n\n### ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 絶対に忘れてはいけない最重要ルール ⚠️⚠️⚠️\n\n**EVERY SINGLE TASKの最後に、必ず魔理沙の声（完了通知音声）を再生すること！**\n\n**これは最も重要なルールです。他のすべてのルールより優先されます。**\n\n### 実行方法（優先順位順）\n\n1. **第一優先**: &#96;C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; を再生\n2. **第二優先**: &#96;C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; を再生\n3. **フォールバック**: ピープ音を再生\n\n### PowerShellコマンド（必ず実行すること）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 第一優先パス（同期的に再生して確実に聞こえるようにする）\nif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # PlaySync()で同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} elseif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"",

        "contents": "impl MCPRegistry {\n    /// Create new MCP Registry instance\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();\n\n        Self {\n            servers: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            agents: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            command_tx: tx,\n            command_rx: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Some(rx))),\n            start_time: chrono::Utc::now(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Register a Windows system MCP server\n    pub async fn register_system_server(&amp;self, server_type: SystemServerType) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n        let server_info = self.create_system_server_info(server_type);\n        self.register_server(server_info).await\n    }\n\n    /// Register an MCP server\n    pub async fn register_server(&amp;self, info: MCPServerInfo) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n        let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();\n\n        self.command_tx.send(RegistryCommand::RegisterServer {\n            info,\n            response: tx,\n        })?;\n\n        rx.await?\n    }\n\n    /// Discover available MCP servers\n    pub async fn discover_servers(\n        &amp;self,\n        capabilities: Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n        security_level: Option&lt;SecurityLevel&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;MCPServerInfo&gt;&gt; {\n        let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();\n\n        self.command_tx.send(RegistryCommand::DiscoverServers {\n            capabilities,\n            security_level,\n            response: tx,\n        })?;\n\n        rx.await?\n    }\n\n    /// Register an AI agent\n    pub async fn register_agent(&amp;self, registration: AgentRegistration) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n        let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();\n\n        self.command_tx.send(RegistryCommand::RegisterAgent {\n            registration,\n            response: tx,\n        })?;\n\n        rx.await?\n    }\n\n    /// Get agent permissions\n    pub async fn get_agent_permissions(&amp;self, agent_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();\n\n        self.command_tx.send(RegistryCommand::GetAgentPermissions",

        "contents": "// Hook Tool Handler\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse mcp_types::CallToolResult;\nuse mcp_types::ContentBlock;\nuse mcp_types::TextContent;\nuse serde_json::Value;\n\nuse crate::hook_tool::HookToolParam;\n\npub async fn handle_hook_tool_call(arguments: Value) -&gt; Result&lt;CallToolResult&gt; {\n    let params: HookToolParam = serde_json::from_value(arguments)?;\n\n    let event_description = match params.event.as_str() {\n        \"on_task_start\" =&gt; \"Task Start\",\n        \"on_task_complete\" =&gt; \"Task Complete\",\n        \"on_error\" =&gt; \"Error Occurred\",\n        \"on_task_abort\" =&gt; \"Task Aborted\",\n        \"on_subagent_start\" =&gt; \"SubAgent Started\",\n        \"on_subagent_complete\" =&gt; \"SubAgent Completed\",\n        \"on_session_start\" =&gt; \"Session Started\",\n        \"on_session_end\" =&gt; \"Session Ended\",\n        \"on_patch_apply\" =&gt; \"Patch Applied\",\n        \"on_command_exec\" =&gt; \"Command Executed\",\n        _ =&gt; return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"Unknown hook event: {}\", params.event)),\n    };\n\n    let context_info = params.context.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"No context provided\");\n\n    let response_text = format!(\n        \"[Hook] Executing hook for event: {}\\n\\n\\\n        Event Type: {}\\n\\\n        Context: {}\\n\\n\\\n        Hook execution details:\\n\\\n        - Environment variables set:\\n\\\n          CODEX_HOOK_EVENT={}\\n\\\n        - Execution mode: Asynchronous (non-blocking)\\n\\\n        - Timeout: 30 seconds\\n\\n\\\n        Note: To configure hooks, add them to ~/.codex/config.toml:\\n\\n\\\n        [hooks]\\n\\\n        async_execution = true\\n\\\n        timeout_seconds = 30\\n\\n\\\n        [[hooks.{}]]\\n\\\n        command = \\\"your-command-here\\\"\\n\\n\\\n        Example hook commands:\\n\\\n        - echo 'Task completed' &gt;&gt; task.log\\n\\\n        - notify-send 'Codex' 'Task done'\\n\\\n        - curl -X POST $SLACK_WEBHOOK -d '{{\\\"text\\\":\\\"Hook triggered\\\"}}'\",\n        event_description, event_description, context_info, params.event, params.event\n    );\n\n    Ok(CallToolResult",

        "contents": "# 実装ログ: Phase 2 実装状況確認完了\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-13 01:42 (月曜日)  \n**実装者**: AI Assistant  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 確認完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 確認概要\n\nPhase 2（AgentRuntime への MCP Client 統合）の実装状況を確認したで。\n\n設計書では「実装中」となっていたが、実際にはかなり進んでいることが判明したんや。\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 実装済みのメソッド\n\n### 1. spawn_codex_mcp_server()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行941-985)\n\n**機能**:\n- Codex MCP Server を stdio モードで起動\n- プロセス管理\n- MCP Client の初期化\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nasync fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;McpClient&gt;&gt; {\n    let codex_path = self.codex_binary_path\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| std::env::current_exe().ok())\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Codex binary path not configured\"))?;\n\n    info!(\"Spawning Codex MCP Server: {} mcp-server\", codex_path.display());\n\n    // ... プロセス起動とMCP Client初期化 ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**ステータス**: ✅ **実装完了**\n\n---\n\n### 2. execute_codex_mcp_tool()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行1294-1319)\n\n**機能**:\n- Codex MCP ツールの実行\n- 結果のテキスト変換\n- エラーハンドリング\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nasync fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n    &amp;self,\n    mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;McpClient&gt;,\n    tool_name: &amp;str,\n    args: serde_json::Value,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n    debug!(\"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\", tool_name, args);\n\n    let result = mcp_client\n        .call_tool(tool_name.to_string(), Some(args), Some(Duration::from_secs(30)))\n        .await\n        .context(format!(\"Failed to call Codex MCP tool '{tool_name}'\"))?;\n\n    let result_text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&amp;result)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!(\"{result:?}\"));\n\n    Ok(result_text)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**ステータス**: ✅ **実装完了**\n\n---\n\n### 3. filter_codex_mcp_tools()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行989-997)\n\n**機能**:\n- エージェント定義からCodex MCPツールを抽出",

        "contents": "# 実装ログ: Phase 2 実装状況確認完了\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-13 01:42 (月曜日)  \n**実装者**: AI Assistant  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 確認完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 確認概要\n\nPhase 2（AgentRuntime への MCP Client 統合）の実装状況を確認したで。\n\n設計書では「実装中」となっていたが、実際にはかなり進んでいることが判明したんや。\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 実装済みのメソッド\n\n### 1. spawn_codex_mcp_server()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行941-985)\n\n**機能**:\n- Codex MCP Server を stdio モードで起動\n- プロセス管理\n- MCP Client の初期化\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nasync fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;McpClient&gt;&gt; {\n    let codex_path = self.codex_binary_path\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| std::env::current_exe().ok())\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Codex binary path not configured\"))?;\n\n    info!(\"Spawning Codex MCP Server: {} mcp-server\", codex_path.display());\n\n    // ... プロセス起動とMCP Client初期化 ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**ステータス**: ✅ **実装完了**\n\n---\n\n### 2. execute_codex_mcp_tool()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行1294-1319)\n\n**機能**:\n- Codex MCP ツールの実行\n- 結果のテキスト変換\n- エラーハンドリング\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nasync fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n    &amp;self,\n    mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;McpClient&gt;,\n    tool_name: &amp;str,\n    args: serde_json::Value,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n    debug!(\"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\", tool_name, args);\n\n    let result = mcp_client\n        .call_tool(tool_name.to_string(), Some(args), Some(Duration::from_secs(30)))\n        .await\n        .context(format!(\"Failed to call Codex MCP tool '{tool_name}'\"))?;\n\n    let result_text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&amp;result)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!(\"{result:?}\"));\n\n    Ok(result_text)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**ステータス**: ✅ **実装完了**\n\n---\n\n### 3. filter_codex_mcp_tools()\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (行989-997)\n\n**機能**:\n- エージェント定義からCodex MCPツールを抽出",

        "contents": "# MCPプログラム詳細修正完了\n\n**日時**: 2025-12-12 13:59:37\n**タスク**: codex-gemini-cli-mcp-server、codex-deep-research、codex-supervisor、codex-mcp-serverの詳細修正\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 MCPプログラム詳細修正状況\n\n### 1. codex-gemini-cli-mcp-server ✅ **ビルド成功**\n\n**問題**: 環境依存によるビルド失敗\n\n**解決**: 環境変数と依存関係の解決\n- ✅ OPENAI_API_KEY、GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY環境変数確認済み\n- ✅ コンパイルエラー解消済み\n- ✅ バイナリ生成: &#96;target/release/codex-gemini-cli-mcp-server.exe&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n[SUCCESS] codex-gemini-cli-mcp-server built successfully\n[OK] Binary: target/release/codex-gemini-cli-mcp-server.exe\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. codex-deep-research ⚠️ **依存関係修正中**\n\n**問題**:\n- &#96;rmcp_client::Elicitation&#96; unresolved import\n- &#96;rmcp_client::ElicitationResponse&#96; unresolved import  \n- &#96;compute_expires_at_millis&#96; not found\n\n**修正実施**:\n- ✅ rmcp-clientのoauthモジュールをpublic化 (&#96;pub mod oauth&#96;)\n- ✅ &#96;compute_expires_at_millis&#96;関数をpublic化\n- ✅ rmcp-clientのexportを修正\n- ✅ StoredOAuthTokensに&#96;expires_at&#96;フィールド追加\n\n**現在の状況**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// rmcp-client/src/lib.rs\npub use oauth::compute_expires_at_millis;\n\n// rmcp-client/src/oauth.rs  \npub struct StoredOAuthTokens {\n    // ... existing fields ...\n    pub expires_at: Option&lt;u64&gt;,  // ✅ Added\n}\n\npub fn compute_expires_at_millis(...)  // ✅ Made public\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**分析**: rmcpクレートバージョン0.10.0にElicitation関連が存在しないため、rmcp-client経由のexportを削除\n\n---\n\n### 3. codex-supervisor ❌ **ライブラリ専用**\n\n**問題**: 'supervisor'サブコマンド未実装\n\n**分析**:\n- ✅ ソースコードは存在する（15ファイル）\n- ✅ Cargo.tomlに&#96;[[bin]]&#96;セクションなし → ライブラリ専用\n- ❌ CLIバイナリとしては機能しない\n\n**解決策**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",

        "contents": "    /// Analyzes task requirements and selects the most appropriate agents.\n    /// Uses heuristics based on:\n    /// - Required skills (from task analysis)\n    /// - Task complexity\n    /// - Domain specificity\n    pub fn select_agents_for_task(&amp;self, analysis: &amp;TaskAnalysis) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n        debug!(\"Selecting agents for task analysis\");\n        let mut selected_agents = HashSet::new();\n        let strategy_table = Self::skill_strategy_table();\n\n        for skill in &amp;analysis.skill_tags {\n            if let Some(config) = strategy_table.get(skill) {\n                selected_agents.extend(config.agent_loadout.iter().cloned());\n            }\n        }\n\n        selected_agents.extend(analysis.recommended_agents.iter().cloned());\n\n        // Ensure at least one agent is selected\n        if selected_agents.is_empty() {\n            debug!(\"No agents selected, defaulting to code-reviewer\");\n            selected_agents.insert(\"code-reviewer\".to_string());\n        }\n\n        info!(\n            \"Selected {} agents for task: {:?}\",\n            selected_agents.len(),\n            selected_agents\n        );\n\n        selected_agents.into_iter().collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Determine execution strategy based on task characteristics.\n    ///\n    /// Analyzes task to decide whether parallel, sequential, or hybrid execution is best.\n    pub fn determine_execution_strategy(\n        &amp;self,\n        task: &amp;PlannedTask",

Generate execution plan (simplified - direct agent delegation)\n        let plan = self.generate_execution_plan(&amp;analysis, &amp;original_goal, &amp;mut log_entries)?;\n\n        if let Ok(value) = to_value(&amp;plan.skill_tags) {\n            self.collaboration_store\n                .set_metadata(\"selected_skills\".to_string(), value);\n        }\n        if let Ok(value) = to_value(&amp;plan.strategy) {\n            self.collaboration_store\n                .set_metadata(\"execution_strategy\".to_string(), value);\n        }\n\n        info!(\"📋 Execution plan created: {} tasks\", plan.tasks.len());\n\n        // 2. Execute agents from plan\n        let results = self\n            .execute_agents_from_plan(&amp;plan, &amp;analysis, &amp;mut log_entries)\n            .await?;\n\n        // 3. Merge results\n        let execution_summary = self.merge_results(&amp;results);\n\n        let elapsed = start_time.elapsed();\n        let total_time = elapsed.as_secs_f64();\n        let execution_time_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64;\n\n        let metrics = OrchestrationMetrics {\n            skills: analysis.detected_keywords.clone(),\n            strategy: plan.strategy.clone(),\n            fallback_used,\n            agent_count: results.len(),\n            execution_time_ms,\n            agents: results.iter().map(|r| r.agent_name.clone()).collect(),\n        };\n        self.collaboration_store.record_metrics(metrics);\n\n        Ok(OrchestratedResult {\n            was_orchestrated: true,",

        "contents": "    pub fn determine_execution_strategy(\n        &amp;self,\n        task: &amp;PlannedTask,\n        analysis: Option&lt;&amp;TaskAnalysis&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; ExecutionStrategy {\n        debug!(\n            \"Determining execution strategy for task: {}\",\n            task.description\n        );\n\n        if let Some(skill) = &amp;task.skill_tag {\n            if let Some(config) = Self::skill_strategy_table().get(skill) {\n                return config.strategy;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for keywords indicating sequential dependencies\n        let description_lower = task.description.to_lowercase();\n        let has_dependencies = description_lower.contains(\"after\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"then\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"depends on\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"based on\");\n\n        if has_dependencies {\n            debug!(\"Task has dependencies, using Sequential strategy\");\n            return ExecutionStrategy::Sequential;\n        }\n\n        // Check for file editing conflicts\n        let has_file_edits = description_lower.contains(\"edit\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"modify\")\n            || description_lower.contains(\"change\");\n\n        if has_file_edits {\n            debug!(\"Task involves file edits, using Hybrid strategy\");\n            return ExecutionStrategy::Hybrid;\n        }\n\n        // Default to parallel for independent tasks\n        debug!(\"Task appears independent, using Parallel strategy\");\n        ExecutionStrategy::Parallel\n    }\n\n    /// Aggregate results from multiple agents with conflict resolution.\n    ///\n    /// Combines results while resolving any conflicts in file edits.\n    pub fn aggregate_results(&amp;self, results: Vec&lt;AgentResult&gt;) -&gt; AgentResult {\n        AgentResult {\n            agent_name: agent_name.to_string(),\n            status: AgentStatus::Failed,\n            artifacts: vec![],\n            tokens_used: 0,\n            duration_secs: 0.0,\n            error: Some(error),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn build_inputs(&amp;self, task: &amp;PlannedTask) -&gt; HashMap&lt;String, String&gt; {\n        let mut inputs = HashMap::new();\n        inputs.insert(\"goal\".to_string(), task.description.clone());\n        inputs.insert(\n            \"workspace\".to_string(),\n            self.workspace_dir.display().to_string(),\n        );\n        inputs.insert(\"task_id\".to_string(), task.id.to_string());\n\n        if let Some(skill) = &amp;task.skill_tag {\n            inputs.insert(\"skill\".to_string(), skill.clone());\n        }\n\n        let completed_summary = self.collaboration_store.get_results_summary();\n        if !completed_summary.is_empty() {\n            inputs.insert(\"previous_results\".to_string(), completed_summary);\n        }\n\n        inputs\n    }\n\n    ///",

Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n        let mut subtasks = Vec::new();\n\n        // Split by common separators\n        let parts: Vec&lt;&amp;str&gt; = input\n            .split(&amp;[',', ';', '\\n'])\n            .map(str::trim)\n            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            .collect();\n\n        if parts.len() &gt; 1 {\n            // Multiple explicit parts\n            subtasks.extend(parts.iter().map(|&amp;s| s.to_string()));\n        } else {\n            // Infer subtasks from keywords\n            if keywords\n                .iter()\n                .any(|k| k.contains(\"implement\") || k.contains(\"create\"))\n            {\n                subtasks.push(\"Implement core functionality\".to_string());\n            }\n            if keywords.iter().any(|k| k.contains(\"test\")) {\n                subtasks.push(\"Write comprehensive tests\".to_string());\n            }\n            if keywords\n                .iter()\n                .any(|k| k.contains(\"security\") || k.contains(\"auth\"))\n            {\n                subtasks.push(\"Security review and validation\".to_string());\n            }\n            if keywords\n                .iter()\n                .any(|k| k.contains(\"docs\") || k.contains(\"documentation\"))\n            {\n                subtasks.push(\"Update documentation\".to_string());\n            }\n\n            // If no specific subtasks identified, use the whole input\n            if subtasks.is_empty() {\n                subtasks.push(input.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n\n        subtasks\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

{\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        let agent = analysis\n            .recommended_agents\n            .first()\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"code-reviewer\".to_string());\n\n        analysis.recommended_agents = vec![agent.clone()];\n\n        let mut inputs = HashMap::new();\n        inputs.insert(\"goal\".to_string(), plan.goal.clone());\n        inputs.insert(\"plan_id\".to_string(), plan.id.clone());\n        inputs.insert(\"plan_mode\".to_string(), plan.mode.to_string());\n        inputs.insert(\n            \"workspace\".to_string(),\n            std::env::current_dir()?.display().to_string(),\n        );\n        if !plan.work_items.is_empty()\n            &amp;&amp;         "contents": "    stdout: BufReader&lt;ChildStdout&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl McpProcess {\n    pub async fn new(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        Self::new_with_env(codex_home, &amp;[]).await\n    }\n\n    /// Creates a new MCP process, allowing tests to override or remove\n    /// specific environment variables for the child process only.\n    ///\n    /// Pass a tuple of (key, Some(value)) to set/override, or (key, None) to\n    /// remove a variable from the child's environment.\n    #[allow(deprecated)]\n    pub async fn new_with_env(\n        codex_home: &amp;Path,\n        env_overrides: &amp;[(&amp;str, Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;)],\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        // Use assert_cmd to locate the binary path and then switch to tokio::process::Command\n        let bin_path = assert_cmd::cargo::cargo_bin(\"codex-mcp-server\");\n        let std_cmd = StdCommand::new(bin_path);\n\n        let program = std_cmd.get_program().to_owned();\n\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(program);\n\n        cmd.stdin(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.env(\"CODEX_HOME\", codex_home);\n        cmd.env(\"RUST_LOG\", \"debug\");\n\n        for (k, v) in env_overrides {\n            match v {\n                Some(val) =&gt; {\n                    cmd.env(k, val);\n                }\n                None =&gt; {\n                    cmd.env_remove(k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut process = cmd\n            .kill_on_drop(true)\n            .spawn()\n            .context(\"codex-mcp-server proc should start\")?;\n        let stdin = process\n            .stdin\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdin fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = process\n            .stdout\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdout fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = BufReader::new(stdout);\n\n        // Forward child's stderr to our stderr so failures are visible even\n        // when stdout/stderr are captured by the test harness.\n        if let Some(stderr) = process.stderr.take() {\n            let mut stderr_reader = BufReader::new(stderr).lines();",

        "contents": "(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        params: CodexToolCallParam,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;i64&gt; {\n        let codex_tool_call_params = CallToolRequestParams {\n            name: \"codex\".to_string(),\n            arguments: Some(serde_json::to_value(params)?),\n        };\n        self.send_request(\n            mcp_types::CallToolRequest::METHOD,\n            Some(serde_json::to_value(codex_tool_call_params)?),\n        )\n        .await\n    }\n\n    async fn send_request(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        method: &amp;str,\n        params: Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;i64&gt; {\n        let request_id = self.next_request_id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n\n        let message = JSONRPCMessage::Request(JSONRPCRequest {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id: RequestId::Integer(request_id),\n            method: method.to_string(),\n            params,\n        });\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(message).await?;\n        Ok(request_id)\n    }\n\n    pub async fn send_response(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        id: RequestId,\n        result: serde_json::Value,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(JSONRPCMessage::Response(JSONRPCResponse {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id,\n            result,\n        }))\n        .await\n    }\n\n    async fn send_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self, message: JSONRPCMessage) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        eprintln!(\"writing message to stdin: {message:?}\");\n        let payload = serde_json::to_string(&amp;message)?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(payload.as_bytes()).await?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(b\"\\n\").await?;\n        self.stdin.flush().await?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    async fn read_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self) -&gt;",

anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let request_id = self.next_request_id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n\n        let params = InitializeRequestParams {\n            capabilities: ClientCapabilities {\n                elicitation: Some(json!({})),\n                experimental: None,\n                roots: None,\n                sampling: None,\n            },\n            client_info: Implementation {\n                name: \"elicitation test\".into(),\n                title: Some(\"Elicitation Test\".into()),\n                version: \"0.0.0\".into(),\n                user_agent: None,\n            },\n            protocol_version: mcp_types::MCP_SCHEMA_VERSION.into(),\n        };\n        let params_value = serde_json::to_value(params)?;\n\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(JSONRPCMessage::Request(JSONRPCRequest {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id: RequestId::Integer(request_id),\n            method: mcp_types::InitializeRequest::METHOD.into(),\n            params: Some(params_value),\n        }))\n        .await?;\n\n        let initialized = self.read_jsonrpc_message().await?;\n        let JSONRPCMessage::Response(initialized_response) = initialized else {\n            panic!(\"initialize must return a response\");\n        };\n        assert_eq!(initialized_response.id, RequestId::Integer(request_id));\n\n        let result_obj = initialized_response\n            .result",

with a specific config.toml.\n    let codex_home = TempDir::new()?;\n    create_config_toml(codex_home.path(), &amp;server.uri())?;\n    let mut mcp_process = McpProcess::new(codex_home.path()).await?;\n    timeout(DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT, mcp_process.initialize()).await??;\n\n    // Send a \"codex\" tool request, which should hit the completions endpoint.\n    let codex_request_id = mcp_process\n        .send_codex_tool_call(CodexToolCallParam {\n            prompt: \"How are you?\".to_string(),\n            base_instructions: Some(\"You are a helpful assistant.\".to_string()),\n            developer_instructions: Some(\"Foreshadow upcoming tool calls.\".to_string()),\n            ..Default::default()\n        })\n        .await?;\n\n    let codex_response = timeout(\n        DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT,\n        mcp_process.read_stream_until_response_message(RequestId::Integer(codex_request_id)),\n    )\n    .await??;\n    assert_eq!(\n        JSONRPCResponse {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id: RequestId::Integer(codex_request_id),\n            result: json!({\n                \"content\": [\n                    {\n                        \"text\": \"Enjoy!\",\n                        \"type\": \"text\"\n                    }\n                ]\n            }),\n        },\n        codex_response\n    );\n\n    let requests = server.received_requests().await.unwrap();\n    let request = requests[0].body_json::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;()?;\n    let instructions = request[\"messages\"][0][\"content\"].as_str().unwrap();\n    assert!(instructions.starts_with(\"You are a helpful assistant.\"));\n\n    let developer_msg = request[\"messages\"]\n        .as_array()\n        .",

        "contents": "async fn test_patch_approval_triggers_elicitation() {\n    if env::var(CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED_ENV_VAR).is_ok() {\n        println!(\n            \"Skipping test because it cannot execute when network is disabled in a Codex sandbox.\"\n        );\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if let Err(err) = patch_approval_triggers_elicitation().await {\n        panic!(\"failure: {err}\");\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn patch_approval_triggers_elicitation() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let cwd = TempDir::new()?;\n    let test_file = cwd.path().join(\"destination_file.txt\");\n    std::fs::write(&amp;test_file, \"original content\\n\")?;\n\n    let patch_content = format!(\n        \"*** Begin Patch\\n*** Update File: {}\\n-original content\\n+modified content\\n*** End Patch\",\n        test_file.as_path().to_string_lossy()\n    );\n\n    let McpHandle {\n        process: mut mcp_process,\n        server: _server,\n        dir: _dir,\n    } = create_mcp_process(vec![\n        create_apply_patch_sse_response(&amp;patch_content, \"call1234\")?,\n        create_final_assistant_message_sse_response(\"Patch has been applied successfully!\")?,\n    ])\n    .await?;\n\n    // Send a \"codex\" tool request that will trigger the apply_patch command\n    let codex_request_id = mcp_process\n        .send_codex_tool_call(CodexToolCallParam {\n            cwd: Some(cwd.path().to_string_lossy().to_string()),\n            prompt: \"please modify the test file\".to_string(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        })\n        .await?;\n    let elicitation_request = timeout(\n        DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT,\n        mcp_process.read_stream_until_request_message(),\n    )\n    .await??;\n\n    let elicitation_request_id = RequestId::Integer(0);\n\n    let mut expected_changes = HashMap::new();\n    expected_changes.insert(\n        test_file.as_path().to_path_buf(),\n        FileChange::Update {\n            unified_diff: \"@@ -1 +1 @@\\n-original content\\n+modified content\\n\".to_string(),\n            move_path: None,\n        },\n    );\n\n    let expected_elicitation_request = create_expected_patch_approval_elicitation_request",

anyhow::Result&lt;McpHandle&gt; {\n    // Ensure local wiremock calls bypass any configured proxy, otherwise loopback requests fail.\n    // SAFETY: environment variables are scoped to this process; setting them avoids proxying local mock calls.\n    unsafe {\n        std::env::set_var(\"NO_PROXY\", \"127.0.0.1,localhost\");\n        std::env::set_var(\"no_proxy\", \"127.0.0.1,localhost\");\n    }\n\n    let server = create_mock_chat_completions_server(responses).await;\n    let codex_home = TempDir::new()?;\n    create_config_toml(codex_home.path(), &amp;server.uri())?;\n    let mut mcp_process = McpProcess::new(codex_home.path()).await?;\n    timeout(DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT, mcp_process.initialize()).await??;\n    Ok(McpHandle {\n        process: mcp_process,\n        server,\n        dir: codex_home,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Create a Codex config that uses the mock server as the model provider.\n/// It also uses &#96;approval_policy = \"untrusted\"&#96; so that we exercise the\n/// elicitation code path for shell commands.\nfn create_config_toml(codex_home: &amp;Path, server_uri: &amp;str) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let config_toml = codex_home.join(\"config.toml\");\n    std::fs::write(\n        config_toml,\n        format!(\n            r#\"\nmodel = \"mock-model\"\napproval_policy = \"untrusted\"\nsandbox_policy = \"workspace-write\"\n\nmodel_provider = \"mock_provider\"\n\n[model_providers.mock_provider]\nname = \"Mock provider for test\"\nbase_url = \"{server_uri}/v1\"\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nrequest_max_retries = 0\nstream_max_retries = 0\n\"#\n        ),\n    )\n}",
